column1: # 077.1 - lekka: Cersei (wladczyni korony) bez ukrycia; Margaery jencem w Krolewskiej Przystani do 077.2.

column15: {=ARM_KR_077_1_U}Cersei springs her trap with a false confession: a knight swears that he lay with Queen Margaery, and the High Sparrow takes the young queen and her cousins into the Great Sept to be questioned. For a fortnight Cersei smiles at court.
column16: {=ARM_KR_077_1_L}Then one of her own former lovers, now a brother of the Faith, confesses all they did together. The septas strip the queen regent of her silks and lock her in a cell with nothing but a bucket.
column18: {=ARM_KR_077_1_Q}The Faith calls witnesses about Queen Margaery. What will you say?

column1: # 077.2 - marsz pokuty; Margaery wolna; Cersei traci wplywy (bez Roberta Stronga - tylko tekst).

column15: {=ARM_KR_077_2_U}To leave her cell, Cersei confesses to the lesser sins and agrees to atone. Shorn and naked, she walks barefoot from the Great Sept to the Red Keep through a city that curses her, pelts her with filth and laughs at her shame.
column16: {=ARM_KR_077_2_L}At the gate Qyburn waits with a cloak and a towering knight in new white armour who never lifts his visor. Ser Kevan Lannister now rules as regent, and the court looks at its queen with open contempt.

column1: # 077.2a - Kevan nie zyje: bez regenta.

column15: {=ARM_KR_077_2a_U}To leave her cell, Cersei confesses to the lesser sins and agrees to atone. Shorn and naked, she walks barefoot from the Great Sept to the Red Keep through a city that curses her, pelts her with filth and laughs at her shame.
column16: {=ARM_KR_077_2a_L}At the gate Qyburn waits with a cloak and a towering knight in new white armour who never lifts his visor. The queen keeps her crown, but her council and her city look at her with open contempt.

column1: # 078.1 - lekka: Daenerys (wladczyni) nie znika z mapy; tekst nie mowi, ze jej nie ma, tylko ze odleciala na kilka dni.

column15: {=ARM_KR_078_1_U}The great fighting pit of Daznak opens with all Meereen in the stands. Then the Sons of the Harpy strike from the crowd, and out of the sky comes the black dragon that flew away long ago, drawn by the smell of blood.
column16: {=ARM_KR_078_1_L}Spears fly at the beast. Daenerys runs out onto the burning sand, climbs onto Drogon's back and is carried away over the walls into the grass sea. Days pass before anyone in the city knows if she still lives.

column1: # 078.2 - Barristan rzadzi miastem w imieniu krolowej.

column15: {=ARM_KR_078_2_U}With the queen gone, Ser Barristan Selmy trusts no one in the pyramid. The honeyed locusts served in the royal box at the pit were poisoned, and someone among the masters wanted the queen dead before the dragon came.
column16: {=ARM_KR_078_2_L}The old knight takes command of the palace and the Unsullied, and rules Meereen in the queen's name until she returns. Outside the walls, the siege goes on.

column1: # 078.2a - Hizdahr w grze (m24): uwieziony = ukryty do wyprawy Daenerys (hide wolno dla postaci z #move).

column15: {=ARM_KR_078_2a_U}With the queen gone, Ser Barristan Selmy trusts no one in the pyramid. The honeyed locusts served in the royal box were poisoned, and the man who urged the queen to taste them was her own husband, Hizdahr zo Loraq.
column16: {=ARM_KR_078_2a_L}The old knight seizes Hizdahr in his chambers, has him locked away, and rules Meereen in the queen's name with the Unsullied at his back. Outside the walls, the siege goes on.

column1: # 079.1 - ok. 40 dni przed AegonInvasionEvent (plan osi Fabuli); same okno i plotki.

column15: {=ARM_KR_079_1_U}The Golden Company breaks its contract with Myr without a word of excuse, something no one can remember it ever doing before. Ten thousand sellswords take ship for the west beneath a banner they have never followed: the three-headed dragon of House Targaryen.
column16: {=ARM_KR_079_1_L}Merchants carry the tale west faster than the fleet itself. Lords along the shores of the Stormlands and Blackwater Bay hear it in their halls, and the wiser ones begin to count their spears.

column1: # 079.2 - ok. 40 dni przed DanyInvasionEvent; same okno i plotki.

column15: {=ARM_KR_079_2_U}Merchant captains from the Free Cities sail into Westerosi ports with the same tale. In Slaver's Bay the dragon queen is gathering ships by the hundred: Meereenese galleys, Volantene war fleets and every hull that can be bought.
column16: {=ARM_KR_079_2_L}Some say she has three dragons grown as large as towers, others that she has one, and that it eats a man a day. Either way the tale ends the same: she means to sail west, and soon.

column1: # 088.1 - Bran przejmuje role trojokiej wrony (flaga k088_raven - wizje z calej mapy, nr 66). Hodor (szablon B) tylko w tekscie.

column15: {=ARM_KR_088_1_U}Alone in a vision, Bran walks among the army of the dead and comes face to face with the Night King, who reaches out and grips his arm. The mark still burns with cold when Bran wakes, and the old seer knows the dead can now see the cave.
column16: {=ARM_KR_088_1_L}They come that night. The children of the forest, the wolf Summer and the three-eyed raven die so that Bran can flee, and gentle Hodor holds the cave door shut with his back while Meera drags Bran away on a sled.

column1: # 088.2 - Bran wraca na mape przy Murze (gdy byl ukryty od nr 66); Benjen tylko w tekscie.

column15: {=ARM_KR_088_2_U}Meera cannot drag the sled much farther, and the dead are close behind. Out of the trees rides a hooded figure swinging a flail of fire: Benjen Stark, Bran's lost uncle, kept from becoming a wight by the children of the forest.
column16: {=ARM_KR_088_2_L}He brings them to the edge of the haunted forest, but he cannot pass the Wall. Bran comes to Castle Black as the three-eyed raven, strange and calm, and waits there for word from home.

column1: # 088.2a - Winterfell trzyma Polnoc (Starkowie albo rod Jona): Bran wraca do Winterfell.

column15: {=ARM_KR_088_2a_U}Meera cannot drag the sled much farther, and the dead are close behind. Out of the trees rides a hooded figure swinging a flail of fire: Benjen Stark, Bran's lost uncle, kept from becoming a wight by the children of the forest.
column16: {=ARM_KR_088_2a_L}He brings them to the edge of the haunted forest, but he cannot pass the Wall. Bran rides on through Castle Black to Winterfell, home at last, though he says he is no longer the boy who left it.

column15: {=ARM_KR_089_1_U}Far from any war, a huge, burn-scarred man splits logs for a wandering septon who is raising a sept with village folk. He was left for dead by the Trident and will not talk about it. The septon tells him it is never too late to stop killing.
column16: {=ARM_KR_089_1_L}Then outlaws hang the septon from his own rafters. Sandor Clegane takes up an axe, finds some of them already hanged by Beric Dondarrion and Thoros of Myr, and joins their hunt for the rest.

column1: # 090.1 - Heartsbane od Randylla (przedmiot ROT przeniesiony od posiadacza); Sam ukryty w drodze (m21).

column15: {=ARM_KR_090_1_U}Samwell Tarly rides out from Oldtown to bring Gilly and the boy home to Horn Hill, where they will be safe. His mother and sister welcome them warmly. His father Randyll does not, and at supper he sneers at his son's black cloak, his books and the wildling girl at his side.
column16: {=ARM_KR_090_1_L}Sam leaves before dawn, and this time he takes something with him: Heartsbane, the Valyrian sword of House Tarly, which his father swore would never be his. Lord Randyll wakes to an empty wall.

column1: # 090.1a - Randyll nie zyje: miecz od matki (z rodu Tarly), bez klotni.

column15: {=ARM_KR_090_1a_U}Samwell Tarly rides out from Oldtown to bring Gilly and the boy home to Horn Hill. His father is dead, and the hall feels emptier and kinder for it. His mother Melessa holds him for a long time.
column16: {=ARM_KR_090_1a_L}Before he leaves, she takes Heartsbane, the Valyrian sword of House Tarly, down from the wall and puts it in his hands. Randyll always swore it would never be Sam's. She thinks otherwise.

column1: # 091.1 - Petyr nie rzadzi Dolina: list bez odpowiedzi.

column15: {=ARM_KR_091_1_U}Before the battle for Winterfell, Sansa writes in secret to the Vale, to the one man who might still send knights north. She tells no one, not even Jon, who counts his small army again and again.
column16: {=ARM_KR_091_1_L}No answer comes. The Vale keeps its knights at home, and the King in the North must face the Bolton host with what he has.

column1: # 091.1a - Petyr Lordem Protektorem Doliny (nr 49): rycerze ida (lekka: relacje; oddzial do armii Jona wymaga akcji wojsk partii).

column15: {=ARM_KR_091_1a_U}Before the battle for Winterfell, Sansa writes in secret to Petyr Baelish, Lord Protector of the Vale. She tells no one, not even Jon, who counts his small army again and again and knows it is not enough.
column16: {=ARM_KR_091_1a_L}The answer comes by raven: the knights of the Vale ride north under the falcon banner. Whether they will arrive in time, Sansa cannot know, and she still says nothing to her brother.

column15: {=ARM_KR_092_1_U}Walking the snow outside Winterfell, Davos Seaworth finds the remains of a pyre and, in the ashes, a small wooden stag he once carved for Princess Shireen with his own hands. He has heard enough by now to understand what happened to her.
column16: {=ARM_KR_092_1_L}Before Jon and his lords he accuses Melisandre, and she does not deny it. Jon will not burn her, but he sends her south and promises she will hang if she ever returns to the North.

column15: {=ARM_KR_092_2_U}In the great hall of Winterfell the northern lords mutter over their cups. Then young Lyanna Mormont rises and shames them one by one: they swore to the Starks, yet stayed home when Jon rode to take back their liege lord's castle.
column16: {=ARM_KR_092_2_L}One by one the lords stand, draw their swords and proclaim him again, not as the choice of dead men but as their own: the White Wolf, King in the North. Jon accepts, and does not look happy about it.

column1: # 093.1 - po ostatnim oknie nr 53; Arya dalej ukryta (wraca w nr 94/98).

column15: {=ARM_KR_093_1_U}The Many-Faced God gives Arya a name to take: an actress in a mummer's troupe. Arya watches the woman for days, comes to like her, and in the end warns her instead of killing her. The House of Black and White does not forgive a servant who chooses.
column16: {=ARM_KR_093_1_L}The waif comes for her with a knife in a crowded street. Bleeding, Arya runs to the dark room where she hid her sword and wins the fight in the dark. Then she takes back her own name and turns west.

column1: # 094.1 lekka (obie): Walder zyje ranny (glowa rodu - smierc tylko succeed w pelnej); gina Black Walder i Lothar.

column15: {=ARM_KR_094_1_U}A serving girl brings old Walder Frey his supper in the hall of the Twins and asks where his sons are. He snaps that they will come. She tells him they are already here, baked into the pie in front of him, and then she tells him her name.
column16: {=ARM_KR_094_1_L}Arya Stark cuts the old man as his men cut her mother, but he lives, ruined and raving, while his heirs fight over the scraps. Black Walder and Lothar, the hands of the Red Wedding, are dead.

column1: # 094.1a PELNA - Walder ginie, dziedzic Stevron Frey (lord_1_1_8).

column15: {=ARM_KR_094_1a_U}A serving girl brings old Walder Frey his supper in the hall of the Twins and asks where his sons are. He snaps that they will come. She tells him they are already here, baked into the pie in front of him, and then she tells him her name.
column16: {=ARM_KR_094_1a_L}Then Arya Stark cuts his throat, as his men cut her mother's at the Red Wedding, and leaves him to bleed over his sons. Ser Stevron Frey inherits the Twins and a house gripped by terror.

column1: # 094.2 lekka (obie): gina Emmon Frey i Walder Rivers, Blizniaki traca lojalnosc i bezpieczenstwo.

column15: {=ARM_KR_094_2_U}Some days later Lord Walder, risen from his sickbed, or someone wearing his face, calls the men of House Frey to a feast in the great hall. He praises the Red Wedding and has wine poured for every Frey who fought there, while the women are sent away.
column16: {=ARM_KR_094_2_L}The wine is poisoned. Several Frey sons and grandsons die choking at the tables before the rest understand. The figure at the high table smiles and walks out, and the Twins become a house of mourning.

column1: # 094.2a PELNA - wiekszosc mezczyzn rodu ginie (o Blizniakach decyduje gra).

column15: {=ARM_KR_094_2a_U}Some days after the old lord's death, a man wearing Walder Frey's face calls the men of House Frey to a feast in the great hall. He praises the Red Wedding and has wine poured for every Frey who fought there, while the women are sent away.
column16: {=ARM_KR_094_2a_L}The wine is poisoned. Nearly every man of House Frey dies choking at the tables. The figure at the high table smiles and walks out, and what is left of the house can barely hold its own castle.

column15: {=ARM_KR_095_1_U}On the day of the trials the Great Sept of Baelor is full: the High Sparrow, Queen Margaery, Ser Loras and the lords of the court all wait for the queen mother, who does not come. Far beneath the floor, caches of old wildfire have waited for years.
column16: {=ARM_KR_095_1_L}From a window of the Red Keep, Cersei watches the sept with a cup of wine in her hand, and waits. Somewhere beneath the city, a candle is burning down.
column18: {=ARM_KR_095_1_Q}You are in the city on the day of the trials. What do you do?

column1: # 095.2 - Cersei na Zelaznym Tronie (w ROT juz wladczyni po JoffreyEvent).

column15: {=ARM_KR_095_2_U}With her son dead and the Faith in ashes, Cersei Lannister is crowned in the throne room, in black, her hair still cropped from the walk. No septon blesses her. Qyburn places the crown on her head himself.
column16: {=ARM_KR_095_2_L}The lords who come to bend the knee are few and quiet. The city stinks of smoke for a month, and in Highgarden and Sunspear old enemies of the Lannisters begin writing to one another.

column1: # 095.2a - gracz ostrzegl Tyrellow: Tommen zyje, Cersei rzadzi zza jego tronu.

column15: {=ARM_KR_095_2a_U}Tommen lives, but his wife and her brother have fled the city and the Faith lies in ashes. Cersei now rules openly from behind her son's throne, and no one at court dares say aloud who lit the fire.
column16: {=ARM_KR_095_2a_L}The lords who come to court are few and quiet. The city stinks of smoke for a month, and in Highgarden the Tyrells, who owe their lives to a warning, begin writing to the enemies of the crown.
